description.value:
Rank 4 Weapon Technique

  • Ki Cost: 100 Ki
  • Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon that you are proficient with & Spirit Bomb
  • Casting Time: Special
  • Range: Self
  • Duration: Special
  • Chargeable: No

When you would absorb a Spirit Bomb, you may channel the ki into your weapon. Your Weapon Damage Die becomes half the Damage of the Spirit Bomb. This Technique has a duration of 1 Round per Spirit Bomb Size. Once the duration of this Technique ends, you gain 2 Ranks of Exhaustion per size of the Spirit Bomb.

system.requirements: 1 *Simple or Martial Weapon* that you are proficient with & Spirit Bomb
